ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme and track the flow of money to identify potential co-conspirators and uncover the scope of the scheme.
questions: How did the suspects launder the money?
Who else was involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and highlight the need for increased oversight of government programs.
